intro: What I use in real work, what I am learning right now, and what comes next. Each skill links to the project that used it.

learnt.name: Learnt
learnt.text: Used in real work: a paper, a thesis or a running project.

learning.name: Learning
learning.text: In progress now, with a project that needs it.

next.name: Next
next.text: Planned, with a date or a project waiting for it.

domains.name: Medical imaging & physics
domains.text: The core of the PhD: simulating PET/CT scanners, inserting lesions into raw data and measuring whether the numbers hold.

domains.name: Simulation & engineering
domains.text: From microwave ablation and blood flow to a robot submarine: physics models checked against experiments.

domains.name: Programming & ML
domains.text: The languages the simulators are written in, and the deep-learning stack I am training on now.

domains.name: Agentic AI & dev tools
domains.text: Teams of AI agents with human gates: they run studies, build software and keep logs I can audit.

domains.name: 3D & creative
domains.text: The village on the home page and the Kage game: modelled, generated and built with agent help.

domains.name: Lab & fabrication
domains.text: Hands-on work: printed phantoms in the scanner, microfluidic chips, soft electrodes and ex vivo burns.

skills.name: PET/CT simulation
skills.evidence: Built CASSOULET: projection, calibrated noise, DOI and TOF scatter for three clinical scanner models.

skills.name: Iterative reconstruction (OSEM, BSREM)
skills.evidence: OSEM and BSREM reconstruction with PSF in CASSOULET, matched to clinical Q.Clear settings.

skills.name: PyTomography
skills.evidence: Reconstruction engine in the Python rebuild of CASSOULET.

skills.name: parallelproj
skills.evidence: GPU projectors for the CASSOULET scanner models and benchmark scripts.

skills.name: Quantitative PET & statistics
skills.evidence: SUV, recovery and contrast metrics with Friedman, Wilcoxon-Holm and TOST tests across the thesis studies.

skills.name: Radiomics (IBSI features)
skills.evidence: 60 IBSI-family features ranked against a printed heterogeneity ground truth (Quantitative Reality, 2025).

skills.name: Dynamic PET
skills.evidence: Dynamic total-body lesion insertion and 3DynaPET validation with printed phantoms.

skills.name: 3D Slicer
skills.evidence: Lesion and phantom segmentations for the printed-cube and heterogeneous-lesion studies.

skills.name: DICOM & NIfTI (pydicom, nibabel)
skills.evidence: Data loading, export and multicentre benchmark scripts around CASSOULET.

skills.name: TotalSegmentator
skills.evidence: Anatomy layer of the Virtual PET Patients pipeline, checked at a human QC gate.

skills.name: Generative models for PET/CT
skills.evidence: Heterogeneous PET synthesis from uniform activity maps (PAD-style), trained on CASSOULET data.

skills.name: Surrogate simulators
skills.evidence: A learned stand-in for CASSOULET (NASGM-style) so a simulation runs in seconds.

skills.name: AI for dosimetry
skills.evidence: Small generative models for PET/CT dosimetry, after the surrogate simulator.

skills.name: COMSOL Multiphysics
skills.evidence: Coupled EM and Pennes bioheat ablation models (30 simulations) and an RBC encapsulation model.

skills.name: CFD: pulsatile two-phase flow
skills.evidence: Gas embolism in an image-based carotid artery, J Biomech Eng 2022.

skills.name: Mass-transport modelling
skills.evidence: Decay-diffusion tracer transport in MuPET, within 0.4-1.2 % of measured activity.

skills.name: Systems engineering (V-cycle)
skills.evidence: Five design iterations of the Black Pearl AUV, OCEANS 2021.

skills.name: Python
